# root-migration

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: `./equin data-dir migrate`: moves an install's data root from the legacy home dir to ~/.equin (and its local backups beside it) in one run, with every other process of the app stopped — rewrites every stored copy of the old path (each database in the cluster, the files under the root, Claude Code's transcript dirs), drops the cache entries that hold it, removes the legacy name once a scan finds none left, and relabels the gateway's login service dev.equin.gateway. A dry run by default; --apply executes.
